Time Machine

Replay a hypothetical move for Robert with an information cutoff

Choose a past date. The rule checks and figures use only data rows available on that date. What happened afterwards stays hidden until you ask to reveal it.

What this replay can and cannot show

The language model’s knowledge is not erased. Figures come from date-filtered data, but wording may reflect what happened later.
Prices are adjusted and macro series are revised: this is not the data as originally published on that date.
The asset universe was selected later, among names that are large today.
This is a historical simulation, not a validation of any forecast and not an offline replay of a real decision.
